name: Return to Primal Torntusk
summary: Elder Torntusk asks you to return to his mate, Primal Torntusk, at Revantusk Village and tell her that he is coming home.

sections.title: News for His Mate
sections.body: Elder Torntusk is free of his bindings, and he asks you to return to Revantusk Village. There you are to tell his mate, Primal Torntusk, that he is coming home.

sections.title: The Village Is Grateful
sections.body: Primal Torntusk says you have served the Revantusk greatly, and that the village owes you a deep debt of thanks.

faq.q: Who sends you on this journey?
aliases: who starts return to primal torntusk
faq.answer: Elder Torntusk asks you to carry the news of his rescue to his mate.

aliases: where to turn in return to primal torntusk
faq.answer: Primal Torntusk is at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What am I supposed to tell Primal Torntusk?
faq.answer: That Elder Torntusk is coming home.
It follows Recover the Key!, after the earlier effort that began in Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
